comments.why_zh: 把 neural nets、gradient descent 和 dot products 串在一起
comments.quote_zh: 我强烈推荐看看 3blue1brown 的系列，讲 neural nets、gradient descent 和 dot product
comments.text_zh: 本质上，计算机 neural network 不过是对 floating point numbers 做大量加法（以及 matrix multiplication）。parameters 就是不同层神经元之间连接的“强度”或“weights”，以及每个神经元的“bias”。如果神经元 Alice 连接到神经元 Bob，Alice 的值是 0.7，Alice 到 Bob 的连接权重是 0.5，那么 Alice 发给 Bob 的值就是 0.35。这个值（以及所有其他传入连接的值）会被求和，并加到该神经元的负 bias 上。我强烈推荐看看 3blue1brown 的系列，讲 neural nets、gradient descent 和 dot product（以 matrix multiplication 实现）如何串在一起：[VIDEO]
comments.text: Essentially a computer neural network is just a lot of addition (and matrix multiplication) of floating point numbers. The parameters are the "strength" or "weights" of the connections between neurons on different layers and the "bias" of each neuron. If neuron Alice is connected to neuron Bob and Alice has a value of 0.7, and the weight of Alice's connection to bob is 0.5, then the value sent from Alice to Bob is 0.35. This value (and the values from all the other incoming connections) are summed at added to the neuron's negative bias. I highly recommend checking out 3blue1brown series on how neural nets, gradient descent, and the dot product (implemented as a matrix multiplication) all tie together: [VIDEO]
